column3: I have called describes a completed cry rather than the present I cry.
The pleas are plural and have a voice or sound; mercy is not a separate noun here.
Waiting and hoping are expressed as completed actions rather than present verbs.
The words watchers for the morning are repeated; more than is not separately repeated in the second phrase.
Israel is redeemed from all his iniquities, with both the possessive and plural expressed.
